description: Trigeminal Neuralgia — full three-layer protocol (Western / Integrative / Backend). Includes carbamazepine-to-herb transition logic and laser protocol.

ICHD3_types.mechanism: Neurovascular compression (superior cerebellar artery) at trigeminal root entry zone (REZ) → demyelination
ICHD3_types.features: Sudden, severe, brief electric-shock pain triggered by non-painful stimuli (touch, chewing)

ICHD3_types.mechanism: Intermediate between typical TGN and trigeminal neuropathic pain

ICHD3_types.features: Continuous dull pain in trigeminal distribution

western_classification.anatomical_note: REZ = Root Entry Zone. Pulse-Plate-Plexus principle. Three branches: V1 (ophthalmic), V2 (maxillary), V3 (mandibular).

prophylaxis_first_line.name: Carbamazepine
prophylaxis_first_line.metabolism: CYP3A4 inducer — induces own metabolism to 10,11-epoxide via cytochrome P450

prophylaxis_first_line.name: Oxcarbazepine
prophylaxis_first_line.mechanism: Na channel blocker — active metabolite monohydroxyl derivative
prophylaxis_first_line.metabolism: Minimal CYP450, weaker inducer, does not induce own metabolism

field_model.core_mechanism: NOT classical nerve pain. Shaoyang gate entrapment (GB–SJ–BL fascia line). Local EZ collapse + Yin deficit → electrical discharges. Nerve = antenna, not the error source.

carbamazepine_field_effects.CYP3A4: strong inducer — reduces other medications (statins, NOACs, hormones, benzodiazepines)
long_term_effects: nerve membrane silencing without true resolution
carbamazepine_field_effects.rule: Cannot be stopped suddenly. Cannot be replaced with cooling formula alone.

NOT_recommended.reason: Too cold. Does not release Shaoyang. Long term risks worsening nerve EZ layer. After carbamazepine → further Yin drying. Acceptable in acute inflammation only — NOT for TGN withdrawal.

RECOMMENDED.rationale: Best axis formula. Releases Shaoyang congestion. Supports liver → CYP system re-regulates. Does not suppress nerve — repositions it.
RECOMMENDED.classification: Field-stabilising Shaoyang formula — NOT a classical recipe

laser_protocol.approach: fascia-gate points, NOT direct nerve burning

recommended_points.rationale: Only if NOT too Yang — peripheral grounding

laser_protocol.legal_safe_label: Peripheral neurofascial modulation at Shaoyang convergence zones and facial fascia-gate points

sequence: 1. Start Shaoyang release FIRST (Xiao Chai Hu Tang modified)
2. Ensure Yin support is established and stable
3. ONLY THEN: slow dose reduction of carbamazepine

Shaoyang still locked — increase ventilation before reduction

diagnosis_map_entry.notes: TGN maps to Yangming node in headache triangle. Field mechanism: Shaoyang gate locked, local EZ collapse, Yin deficit → electrical discharge. Nerve is antenna not error source. Carbamazepine = CYP3A4 inducer — herb interactions critical.

rules.action: REJECT for long-term use. Too cold. Risks worsening nerve EZ. Acceptable acute inflammation only.

rules.condition: TGN AND carbamazepine_current == true AND herb_formula_starting == true
rules.action: Start Shaoyang release and Yin support FIRST. Do NOT reduce carbamazepine until herbal foundation is stable.
Yin insufficient. Increase Yin support (Mai Men Dong, Wu Wei Zi, Sheng Di). Do NOT reduce carbamazepine yet.
Shaoyang still locked. Increase Shaoyang ventilation (Chai Hu, Yu Jin). Do NOT reduce carbamazepine yet.
FORBIDDEN. Target fascia-gate points only. Goal: EZ reordering, not nociceptor block.
CAUTION. High Vitamin D can cause neural over-tension. Moderate dose only.
FLAG. Secondary TGN (MS, tumour, Lyme) must be excluded before integrative pathway.

notes: TGN maps to the Yangming node in the headache triangle but has its own dedicated module with carbamazepine transition logic — this is clinically critical and must not be merged with general Yangming pattern.
Carbamazepine-herb interactions are a critical safety rule: carbamazepine is a strong CYP3A4 inducer and reduces multiple drug classes. Any herb formula co-prescription must account for this.
Wu Wei Zi is flagged as KEY for nerve membrane stabilisation in TGN — this should be a required herb whenever EZ instability is the primary mechanism.
The Vitamin D caution (moderate dose only — excess causes neural over-tension) is a new rule not present in earlier modules.
Nigella sativa is flagged as a safe anti-inflammatory that does NOT block Shaoyang — useful when anti-inflammatory support is needed without compromising the ventilation axis.
